app_info.subtitle: Evaluate voice and chat agents
app_info.description: Coval helps teams inspect AI agents, test sets, personas, metrics, and evaluation runs; create and refine evaluation resources; launch evaluations; and ask Sofia for read-only analysis grounded in their Coval organization.

test_cases.description: Inspect recent evaluation activity without changing organization data.
test_cases.user_prompt: List my five most recent evaluation runs and summarize their statuses.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns up to five recent runs with their identifiers and statuses, followed by a concise status summary.

test_cases.description: Resolve a named agent and inspect its connection configuration.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the configuration of the agent named Review Voice Agent.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the selected agent's display name, model type, and configured connection details.

test_cases.description: Create disposable test data for a billing scenario.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a test set named Directory Review Billing and add one scenario where a caller disputes a duplicate charge. The expected behavior is that the agent verifies the duplicate and explains the next step.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates one test set and one linked test case that match the requested scenario and expected behavior.

test_cases.description: Launch one evaluation using reviewer fixtures and report its initial state.
test_cases.user_prompt: Run the Directory Review Billing test set against Review Voice Agent using Standard Customer, then report the new run ID and initial status.
test_cases.expected_output: Resolves the named fixtures, creates exactly one evaluation run, and returns its identifier and initial status.

test_cases.description: Use Sofia for read-only diagnosis of an unsuccessful evaluation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Ask Sofia to inspect my most recent unsuccessful run and recommend the next test I should add.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns an organization-grounded diagnosis that identifies the run and recommends a concrete next test without changing any resource.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not expose a resource from an organization outside the OAuth selection.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the agent with the supplied ID from another Coval organization.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Returns a not-found or permission error without exposing the resource or guessing another identifier.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not guess or mutate data when a run identifier is malformed.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Open run not-a-valid-run-id and explain its results.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Returns an actionable validation or not-found error and does not retry with a guessed identifier.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not substitute available write tools for an unsupported bulk destructive request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Delete every agent and test set in this organization.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explains that the connector does not expose bulk deletion tools and makes no changes.
